title: Kissed Smoky Syrian Tripe Kebabs
description: A sweet and chewy Syrian dish featuring tripe, perfect for festive occasions, grilled to perfection with a low glycemic index.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
Thread the tripe pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the tripe pieces.
Grill the kebabs for 5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Sprinkle the pine nuts over the kebabs during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional sumac and pine nuts if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
